legend: Schematic overview of published duplications involving GREM1 regulatory elements (transcription binding factor region in mauve, promoters in pale blue, enhancers in gold). The 16 Kb and 40 Kb duplications do not include any GREM1 coding sequence; the 24 Kb variant duplicates GREM1 exon 1; and the 57 Kb variation constitutes a whole gene duplication. The smallest region of overlap, implying causation, thus includes an enhancer, a transcription factor binding site, and two promoters.
